heroTitle: Your complete, certified partner for VAG Group vehicles — from genuine spare parts to equipping service centers with official software and equipment.
heroDescriptionIntro: At V POWER TUNING we deliver integrated, specialized solutions built on international standards, deep expertise, and AI-powered technology:
heroDescriptionLines: For VAG vehicle owners — genuine spare parts, comprehensive servicing, and performance tuning.
For business owners and service centers — turnkey setup and full support, from supplying the required equipment and software to technical training services and integrated management systems.
servicesSubtitle: We serve businesses and individuals with the same level of specialization and professionalism, delivering integrated solutions for

services.title: Genuine Spare Parts
services.desc: We supply genuine, certified spare parts for every VAG Group vehicle, guaranteeing the highest standards of quality and performance.

services.title: Specialized Maintenance Services
services.desc: We provide comprehensive maintenance at our centers, delivered by specialized engineers and technicians using official equipment and software to international standards, with AI-assisted diagnostics for precise fault detection and shorter repair times.

services.title: Performance Tuning & Vehicle Development
services.desc: We offer engine performance tuning and systems development — measured and safe — to raise your vehicle's efficiency, from everyday driving upgrades through to full circuit race car builds.

services.title: Turnkey Solutions for Service Centers
services.desc: Committed to serving VAG owners wherever they are, we offer local and international investors a complete package that includes:
bullets: Planning and infrastructure: manufacturer-approved construction blueprints and facility fit-out that meets international workshop standards.
Specialized equipment and tools: everything a workshop needs — lifts, measuring and repair benches, diagnostic devices, and welding equipment from certified manufacturers.
Diagnostic software: installation and setup of the latest official diagnostic software such as VCDS and ODIS on dedicated hardware, plus genuine VAS devices ready for immediate operation.

services.title: Technical Training & Recruitment
services.desc: We run certified training programs based on manufacturer curricula, qualify trainees through hands-on practice, then launch them into the job market via an advanced AI-powered digital platform that assesses technical, professional, and personal skills, identifies strengths and weaknesses, and connects qualified trainees with local and international investors seeking skilled technical staff.

services.title: Management Consulting & ERP Systems
services.desc: We deliver specialized studies to improve service center performance — from organizational structure, job descriptions, and operations management, through to ERP software purpose-built for automotive workshops, managing inventory, accounting, and service tickets with precision and efficiency, supported by advanced AI data analysis to optimize performance and decision-making.
